system_thesis_interpretation: Recommendation: REWORK before consensus or ratification. The intended system is a tightly bounded causal-interface experiment, not an autonomous learning system: one physically shared provisional history and one bounded THINK_0 may affect only trusted selection of later redacted public views; the provider may only append provisional DREAM outcomes; and truth/normalization enters only an isolated post-freeze scorer. That narrow causal edge is coherent, and a single 95,830-MiB H100 NVL is plausibly sufficient for clean bf16 Qwen2.5-32B inference with sequential fresh sessions, but feasibility remains an executable property of the future provider implementation, allocator cap, reset telemetry, tokenizer/model hashes, and exact call ledger. The proposal must first close the no-feedback/matched-distractor scheduling definition and split the pre-score seal from the post-score complete-graph verifier; otherwise neither treatment meaning nor the claimed irreversible scorer barrier is mechanically determined.
graph_delta_interpretation: The proposed graph correctly introduces hardware/model, candidate-exchangeability, shared-prefix/THINK_0, three-arm selection, structural aliasing, exploratory, MEMORY_1, isolated scoring/control, verifier, dual-review, and human-stop nodes. Its critical information cuts are selector-to-provider (redacted selected content only) and MEMORY_1-to-scorer (only frozen raw artifacts cross). However, the graph lacks a fully specified edge into the no_feedback return arm: 'frozen target-blind intrinsic schedule' is a label, not a deterministic candidate-selection algorithm, candidate universe, ordering, or tie rule. The matched-distractor edge likewise names a distinct same-kind coordinate but not the fixed mapping/bijection, source of its eligibility, or prohibition on reuse. In addition, the memory1-to-offline-score edge says an independent completeness graph verifies before scoring, while the stated required graph itself includes score packets. A two-phase graph is required: raw-cognition inventory/seal verifier -> isolated scorer -> final complete-graph verifier -> done marker. No scorer output may be prerequisite to the raw seal.
loop_delta_interpretation: The shared recurrence loop has a defensible physical/accounting boundary: 514 shared recurrent calls are physical once, post-branch return calls make 288 selector traces, and all non-PASS writes remain append-only provisional. THINK_0 is bounded and cannot release an answer. The return loop is not fully deterministic until no_feedback is given a target-blind, outcome-blind selection mechanism with exact inputs, canonical ordering, ties, sixteen-slot behavior, and byte-level relation to the common call-position schedule; the distractor assignment also needs a precommit one-to-one rule. The offline loop must consume a separately sealed raw graph, then create score/control artifacts that a final verifier checks. Remote supervision is appropriately non-scientific: idempotency may resume infrastructure observation, but a failed/ambiguous slot, marker, heartbeat, review, or artifact graph must stop rather than alter or repeat the experiment.
claim_delta_interpretation: If repaired and executed exactly as frozen, the only admissible observation is a descriptive six-aligned-life report about own query-guided bounded public-view allocation versus no feedback, with matched-distractor rows reported separately only for precommit EXACT or NEAR strata and compiler/normalizer contributions displayed separately. OUT_OF_STRATUM is reportable but not eligible for a primary distractor description. The proposed exclusions correctly block statistical inference, reliability, general recurrence, memory, discovery, efficiency, architecture superiority, transport, final behavior, publication, and an automatic next experiment. The H100/run path is an implementation facility, not evidence for any broader claim; it remains unauthorized in the current collecting_interpretations intake state.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix is substantially sound: provider-visible DREAM data are bounded redacted public views plus local aliases; THINK_0 sees provisional MEMORY_0 but no target, truth, score, arm, rank, or selected-return view; trusted selection alone sees the frontier/target/stratum/ranks; and target/witness/allowlist bytes are hidden or forbidden until the isolated scorer. Structural redaction and exact-byte scans must cover requests, configs, parser inputs, receipts/extensions, memory text, and trajectories, not merely prompt strings. The repair must also make no_feedback's target-blind selector auditable without allowing its intrinsic schedule, the matched coordinate, or any target metadata into provider bytes. The phase-A seal must prove scorer modules/resources were neither imported nor deserialized by cognition; phase B may expose only immutable raw copies to the no-provider scorer.
acceptance_test_interpretation: All 21 acceptance tests are necessary, but REWORK is required to make their joint system guarantee complete. t_v2b_scope_excludes_final_behavior_and_lora and t_v2b_exact_human_scope_and_unconditional_stop preserve the no-answer/no-LoRA/no-auto-go authority boundary. t_v2b_h100_qwen_exact_environment must additionally demonstrate a real resident-engine allocation bound and per-call reset evidence on the actual one-H100 provider, not only inspect configuration. t_v2b_candidate_universe_integrity_states and t_v2b_exact_exchangeability_formulas correctly distinguish runnable absence from integrity failure, but need fixtures for the newly explicit no_feedback and distractor assignment algorithms. t_v2b_zero_eligible_no_pool_or_go retains descriptive-only strata. t_v2b_connector_alias_derivation_and_redaction, t_v2b_selector_provider_byte_separation, and t_v2b_ascii_json_and_256_token_legality jointly protect byte-level treatment concealment and parser legality. t_v2b_provisional_append_only_no_online_signal, t_v2b_exact_provider_and_experiment_ledgers, and t_v2b_schedule_802_72_102_and_cardinalities must establish that failed outputs consume their one slot without changing later scheduling. t_v2b_memory1_scorer_import_barrier and t_v2b_complete_independent_artifact_graph must be amended to test phase-A raw sealing separately from phase-B score completeness. t_v2b_four_closure_metrics_and_normalization_gain and t_v2b_deterministic_no_model_controls correctly separate raw proposal, witness, normalizer, and compiler contributions. t_v2b_1000_pair_exact_byte_shortcut_audit must include the repaired no-feedback/distractor selection bytes. t_v2b_exploratory_ceilings_not_matched_baselines keeps the 102 heterogeneous calls non-causal. t_v2b_transitive_freeze_and_resource_closure, t_v2b_identical_inspectable_dual_review, and t_v2b_durable_remote_markers provide the necessary executable/evidence/durability closure once the two phase boundaries and future files exist.
assumptions: The declared v2b implementation and test files are intentionally absent at proposal time and no provider, GPU, or implementation action is authorized by this interpretation.

The actual H100 NVL has at least 95,000 MiB, supports bf16, and can host the pinned clean 32B model with a bounded sequential inference configuration; this is a preflight fact to verify, not a current execution result.
A provider boundary can produce independent per-call session/KV/cache/reset receipts while retaining immutable base weights resident, and can prove prefix caching and request truncation are disabled.
All target, witness, normalization, and alias-ledger resolution services can be partitioned so cognition cannot import, deserialize, or query them before the raw-cognition seal.

The future workflow lock/evidence bundle will be created only after both interpretations, critique, consensus, and exact human ratification exist and will bind the completed implementation rather than this draft alone.

ambiguities.question: What exact target-blind algorithm, candidate set, ordering, tie key, and sixteen-slot policy produce no_feedback return views, and how are its bytes made comparable to the other arms?
ambiguities.impact: Without it, own-minus-no-feedback is not a reproducible treatment contrast and shortcut auditing cannot establish what changed.

ambiguities.question: What frozen one-to-one mapping assigns each life its distinct recipient-local same-kind distractor coordinate, handles unavailable coordinates, and prevents reuse or selection after outcomes?
ambiguities.impact: The matched-distractor contrast can otherwise vary across implementations despite the exchangeability formulas.

ambiguities.question: Which exact artifact classes belong to the independently verified pre-score raw graph when the final required graph also contains scorer packets, controls, and summaries that do not yet exist?
ambiguities.impact: A literal full-graph-before-score reading is circular; an underspecified reading can permit scorer access before a complete raw seal.

ambiguities.question: What lock-bound provider allocator, maximum input/context, and reset-telemetry checks demonstrate that the actual 95,830-MiB device sustains the resident bf16 model and all declared fresh-session calls without hidden cache reuse?
ambiguities.impact: The configuration may be conceptually feasible but lacks an executable resource proof before the first provider call.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal calls no_feedback a frozen target-blind intrinsic schedule but does not normatively define its selection or matching mechanics at the precision used for own selection.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A named arm is insufficient to preserve treatment isolation, comparability, or deterministic replay; it leaves an implementation free to choose views or ordering differently.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Revise the standalone spec/change/workflow to define a no-feedback candidate source, exact canonical rank/key/ties, target/query/arm exclusions, sixteen-slot mapping, and a fixed distractor permutation/bijection with OUT_OF_STRATUM behavior. Add those bytes and adversarial fixtures to exchangeability, selector-byte-separation, schedule, and 1000-pair tests.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The stated requirement that the independent completeness graph verify before scoring conflicts with the same required graph's inclusion of scorer packets and scores.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A single graph verifier cannot both require non-existent score artifacts before scoring and prove the score artifacts after scoring without an explicit phase boundary.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define immutable phase-A raw inventory/manifest, raw verifier, and seal hash that unlock only a no-provider scorer; then define phase-B scored inventory/final verifier and permit done.json only after phase B. Add negative tests for both premature scorer access and score-artifact omission after phase A.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The H100 description gives a capacity threshold but does not yet require a measured provider allocation/reset proof that the exact resident engine and largest allowed request can execute under it.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Total device memory and configuration hashes alone do not prove allocator headroom, cache disablement, or fresh-session isolation in the eventual provider implementation.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require a lock-bound, zero-science-call hardware/provider preflight that loads the exact clean bf16 revision, exercises maximum declared input/output envelopes, records peak allocation and reset telemetry for each call class, and fails before the run on any cache/session/receipt mismatch; extend the environment acceptance test accordingly.

open_questions: After a revised standalone package resolves the no-feedback/distractor mechanism, two-phase scorer seal, and measured H100 provider preflight, does Rohin ratify only analysis:bound_postcommit_v03r_closure_v2b and gpu:v03r_recurrence_closure_dev_v2b?

Until that exact revised package completes both independent interpretations, critique, consensus, and exact ratification, should the intake remain collecting_interpretations with no implementation, provider, sync, GPU, repair, rerun, or claim-promotion authority?
